description: Use when the user names a songwriter or composer and wants to know who they are, which person a name belongs to, or every registration of that writer. Returns the persons the name could be: each with a person ID, the names and IPI name numbers they are registered under, how many works, and a person_url to cite. Pairs listed under possibly_the_same_person were held apart and are not merged; `why` says why. Candidates are this lookup's own grouping, made afresh for the name, and can differ from the stored person that get_songwriter and the person page describe: a candidate can include records with no IPI name number that the stored person lists apart, and two candidates can carry the same person_id when this lookup keeps apart records the stored person joined. Each record's person_id is the stored person it belongs to, or null; person_records is how many records that person holds, and records_not_in_this_answer how many of them this candidate does not, because they sit in another candidate or outside this lookup. For a person's registrations as they stand, call get_songwriter. A candidate's works counts every record in it, records held apart from the person included; the person's own count is get_songwriter's works.total. Registrations are under legal names: a writer known by a professional or stage name may not be found by it. If the writer you expect is not among the candidates, or song_match.match is none, try their legal name. truncated means more registrations matched than one answer groups: a fuller name narrows it. Give a song title they wrote, when known, to say which of several namesakes wrote it. A one-word name is not searched: ask for the full name.
